핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

서울 아파트 시장은 매매·전세 상승세가 소폭 둔화되는 모습을 보이고 있으며, 특히 강남·용산 등 주요 고가 지역에서는 매매가 하락세가 이어지고 있어 시장의 열기가 일부 식고 있는 신호가 감지됩니다. 반면 건설 현장에서는 공사비가 7개월 연속 최고치를 경신하며 비용 부담이 가중되고 있는데, 중동 전쟁에 따른 원자재·에너지 가격 상승이 주요 원인으로 작용하고 있습니다. 이처럼 주택 수요 측면에서는 가격 상승 압력이 약해지는 반면, 공급 측면에서는 공사비 급등으로 신규 주택 공급 여건이 악화되는 **수급 간 엇박자** 양상이 나타나고 있습니다. 결과적으로 건설 원가 상승이 향후 분양가 인상으로 이어질 가능성이 있어, 단기적인 가격 안정에도 불구하고 중장기적인 주거비 부담 완화를 기대하기는 어려운 상황입니다.

top5_headlines.summary: 구윤철 부총리, 30일 확대 거시경제금융회의 개최 美 FOMC 금리 동결 영향 점검…향후 대응책 논의 "연준, 시장 예상대로 금리 동결…불확실성 지속" [서울=뉴시스] 배훈식 기자 = 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 30일 오전 서울 중구 은행회관에서 열린 확대 거시경제 금융회의에서 발언하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: ‘ 다주택자 편법증여 ’ 내달 9일 이후 고강도 전수조사한다
top5_headlines.summary: 양도세 중과 유예 종료 시점 국세청, 의심물건 검증 강화 최고 40% 가산세 부과 예고 3월 수도권 인허가 36.4% ↓ ‘주택 공급 절벽’ 현실화 우려 국세청이 오는 5월 9일 양도소득세 중과 유예 종료에 맞춰 고가 아파트 편법 증여 의심 사례에 대한 전수조사를 고강도로 실시한다.

key_headlines.title: Seoul apartment rental market shifts toward monthly rent, monthly rent ratio exceeds 50% for first time
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment monthly rental transactions surpassed 50% of total rental transactions in Q1 2026, reflecting ongoing 'jeonse-to-monthly rent' conversion trend due to jeonse supply shortage and strengthened occupancy requirements from previous government regulations.

key_headlines.title: LG Energy Solution secures 10 trillion won BMW electric vehicle battery supply contract
key_headlines.summary: LG Energy Solution signed a 10 trillion won contract to supply cylindrical batteries (100GWh+) to German automaker BMW, marking a recovery opportunity for Korea's secondary battery industry after the electric vehicle demand cliff.

key_headlines.title: Construction costs hit 7-month consecutive record high amid Middle East war escalation
key_headlines.summary: Construction costs continue rising at record levels for seven consecutive months, with the pace of increase accelerating due to Middle East war uncertainties affecting global supply chains and energy prices.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Financial Authorities confirm crisis response capability amid geopolitical uncertainty
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Gu Yun-chul and Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song assured that authorities have sufficient capacity to respond to financial and forex market volatility triggered by Iran-US war tensions and global uncertainties.

key_headlines.title: Brent crude oil reaches 4-year high of 126 dollars per barrel amid Iran military operation concerns
key_headlines.summary: Brent crude oil futures surged to 126.41 dollars per barrel, the highest level since June 2022, as escalating military tensions between the US and Iran create new supply concerns.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic situation reflects heightened external uncertainties combined with domestic structural challenges. The central government and financial authorities are emphasizing their readiness to respond to potential crises including forex volatility and inflation pressures stemming from geopolitical tensions. Seoul's real estate market is undergoing significant transformation with monthly rent surpassing jeonse transactions for the first time, signaling shifting housing finance dynamics. Construction costs continue climbing to record levels due to Middle East war impacts on global supply chains. Commodity price spikes, particularly in oil markets reaching 4-year highs, are intensifying inflation concerns across the economy.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Major global central banks including the ECB and Bank of England held rates steady, citing heightened inflation risks from geopolitical events and economic growth uncertainties. The ECB maintained its deposit rate at 2.00%, benchmark rate at 2.15%, and marginal lending rate at 2.40%, while acknowledging upside inflation risks and downside growth risks have increased. Bank of England kept rates at 3.75% for the third consecutive meeting. Korea's financial authorities convened the expanded macroeconomic and financial meeting to monitor potential risks from the Iran-US conflict, including supply chain disruptions and inflation pressures. Some market analysts project potential rate increases in Korea later this year despite the current hold pattern.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 1.38% to close at 6598.87, breaching the 6600 level amid international oil price spikes and hawkish rate hold signals from central banks. The KOSDAQ also retreated as foreign investors sold 1.46 trillion won worth of stocks while individuals and institutions bought 1.19 trillion won and 283.8 billion won respectively. Three FOMC members notably dissented from the accommodative policy language, marking the largest policy disagreement since 1992 and signaling divisions within the US Federal Reserve. Korea's stock market remains pressured by external uncertainties including geopolitical tensions, uncertain US monetary policy direction, and increased currency volatility.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korea's secondary battery industry is experiencing recovery momentum with LG Energy Solution securing a major 10 trillion won contract with BMW for cylindrical EV batteries (100GWh+), while Samsung SDI secured Mercedes-Benz as a new customer. The industry is transitioning from the electric vehicle demand cliff that pressured it in recent periods. Energy efficiency equipment demand is rising sharply as AI-driven data center construction accelerates and energy cost burdens increase. Market focus is shifting toward CPU-related stocks as on-device AI PC demand grows, attracting investor attention alongside traditional GPU and memory semiconductor plays in the AI expansion cycle.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment rental market shows fundamental structural changes with monthly rent surpassing jeonse for the first time, reaching 50.8% of all apartment rental transactions in Q1 2026. Seoul's overall housing showed 70.5% monthly rent ratio, reflecting severe jeonse supply shortage and rising prices following stricter occupancy requirements. Smaller apartments (59㎡) are increasingly supplied in new projects, exceeding the traditional national standard 84㎡ units, as developers maximize unit counts to boost profit margins. Seocho-gu apartment prices turned positive after 10 weeks, with transaction activity concentrated in sub-1.5 billion won segments showing resilience ahead of multiple home owner capital gains tax enhancement on May 10.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve maintained rates at 3.50% with significant internal disagreement, as three FOMC members opposed the accommodative policy language in the statement, representing the largest dissent since 1992. Fed Chair Jerome Powell announced his intention to remain on the Federal Reserve Board after his chairmanship ends in June, citing ongoing political pressures and investigations. Powell's decision to remain creates an awkward situation with incoming Chair Kevin Warsh, potentially creating governance challenges. Global economic outlook deteriorates as geopolitical tensions between US and Iran intensify, with Middle East conflict stalling peace negotiations and fueling inflation and supply chain disruption concerns across major economies.
sections.AI & Economy: AI unicorn companies are advancing toward IPO with substantial pre-IPO investments, as Rebellion AI secured 250 billion won from the National Growth Fund directly and additional funding from Korea Development Bank and Mirae Asset. AI industry rapid growth is accelerating data center construction, driving demand for high-efficiency cooling and heating systems to manage rising energy costs. The labor market faces significant restructuring as AI exposure affects employment, with Bank of Korea analysis showing youth employment has already declined sharply in AI-exposed sectors over the past three years. Semiconductor companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix are considering strategic AI-related acquisitions with record 95 trillion won combined Q1 operating profits, representing unprecedented super-cycle opportunities to strengthen AI positioning.
sections.Others: Woori Bank held a US investment briefing session to support small and mid-sized enterprises entering the US market amid strengthened trade protectionism and tariff negotiations. Public institutions' debt ratio declined 6.4 percentage points to 174.1%, while new hiring expanded by 7,000 positions to 27,000, with average employee salaries reaching 74 million won. Labor unions held major May Day demonstrations demanding recognition of gig worker status and constitutional labor rights for irregular workers, including special employment and platform-based laborers. Brent crude oil reached 126 dollars per barrel, the highest level in 4 years, as military operation concerns regarding Iran escalate amid stalled ceasefire negotiations.
